question:
Patients must be able to call in and book, reschedule, or cancel visits by speaking to Thalvox's scheduling agent, with no human scheduler involved.

What should the team implement?

options.text: Integrate real-time speech-to-text and text-to-speech with the scheduling agent, so spoken requests are transcribed, matched to the agent's booking/reschedule/cancel tools, and the agent's reply is read back to the caller.
Build a fixed touch-tone (DTMF) menu that routes every call to the existing human scheduling team.
Expose the scheduling agent only through the patient web portal's text chat window.
Record voicemails from callers and have a staff member transcribe and act on them the next business day.

explanation:
Adding **speech as an agent modality** — real-time speech-to-text feeding the agent's tool-calling loop, and text-to-speech reading the response back — is what lets a caller complete a booking, reschedule, or cancellation entirely by voice, with the agent (not a person) handling the request.

**Why not the other options:**
- **A DTMF menu to a human team** — Still requires a human scheduler on the other end, which is exactly what the requirement says to remove.
- **Text chat only** — Does not serve patients who *call in*; it solves a different channel and leaves phone callers unserved.
- **Voicemail reviewed the next business day** — Fails the "agent handles it" and any real-time expectation implied by a live phone call; it reintroduces a human in the loop with a full-day delay.
category: Implement generative AI and agentic solutions
